permutationLabel: Pregnancy, 26 weeks — ASGE high risk, obstructive jaundice
summary: 31-year-old at 26 weeks with RUQ pain and jaundice; bilirubin 78, ALP 380 (partly placental), ALT 280; ultrasound shows an 11 mm CBD with a distal stone; afebrile; live fetus.

inputs.chiefComplaint: Yellow eyes and upper abdominal pain in pregnancy
inputs.hpi: G1 at 26 weeks. Three days of intermittent right upper quadrant pain, then yellow eyes, dark urine and itching for two days. No fever or rigors. Fetal movements normal, no bleeding or contractions.

exam.general: Jaundiced. Temperature 37.0°C, pulse 92/min, BP 112/68. Gravid uterus appropriate for dates.
exam.abdomen: Right upper quadrant tenderness, no guarding.

imaging.name: USS abdomen
imaging.result: Gallstones. CBD dilated to 11 mm with a 7 mm shadowing stone in the distal duct. Single live intrauterine fetus.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Choledocholithiasis in pregnancy
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Choledocholithiasis with obstructive jaundice at 26 weeks’ gestation — ASGE 2019 high risk (stone on ultrasound). No cholangitis.

guideline.name: ASGE guideline on the role of endoscopy in the evaluation and management of choledocholithiasis
guideline.section: Risk strata. High: CBD stone on US/cross-sectional imaging, or total bilirubin >4 mg/dL with dilated CBD, or ascending cholangitis → ERCP. Intermediate: abnormal liver tests, age >55, or dilated CBD → EUS/MRCP or intra-operative cholangiography/laparoscopic US. Low: none → cholecystectomy without further CBD evaluation
guideline.citation: Buxbaum JL, Abbas Fehmi SM, Sultan S, et al. Gastrointest Endosc. 2019;89:1075–1105.e15.

guideline.name: ASGE guideline — endoscopy in pregnant and lactating women
guideline.section: Therapeutic ERCP only for strong indications (choledocholithiasis, cholangitis, gallstone pancreatitis); minimise fluoroscopy; obstetric support
guideline.citation: Shergill AK, Ben-Menachem T, Chandrasekhara V, et al. Gastrointest Endosc. 2012;76:18–24.

guideline.name: ESGE guideline — endoscopic management of common bile duct stones
guideline.section: ERCP for CBD stones; EUS/MRCP for intermediate probability; peri-procedural considerations including pregnancy
guideline.citation: Manes G, Paspatis G, Aabakken L, et al. Endoscopy. 2019;51:472–491.

guideline.name: ACOG Committee Opinion No. 723 — Guidelines for diagnostic imaging during pregnancy and lactation
guideline.section: US and MRI preferred; CT not contraindicated when needed; gadolinium only if it clearly improves diagnosis
guideline.citation: ACOG Committee Opinion No. 723. Obstet Gynecol. 2017;130:e210–e216.

guideline.name: ACOG Committee Opinion No. 775 — Nonobstetric surgery during pregnancy
guideline.section: Obstetric consultation before non-obstetric surgery; fetal heart rate assessment before and after the procedure
guideline.citation: ACOG Committee Opinion No. 775. Obstet Gynecol. 2019;133:e285–e286.

guideline.name: US FDA Drug Safety Communication — NSAIDs in pregnancy at 20 weeks or later
guideline.section: Avoid NSAIDs from about 20 weeks’ gestation (fetal renal dysfunction, oligohydramnios)
guideline.citation: US Food and Drug Administration. Drug Safety Communication, 15 October 2020.

rationale: Permutation: pregnancy. The high-risk stratum still means ERCP, adapted for pregnancy (minimal fluoroscopy, obstetric support). Tests the pregnancy flag and drug/imaging safety.
